Rules that tell owners and admins when events or money look wrong: an error that happens too often,
too many failed attempts, an event that stopped arriving, or a metric such as MRR, revenue or trials
crossing a value or moving by a share. Each rule is checked every hour.

Usage:
  voidhash analytics alerts <command> [flags]

Commands:
  list       List the project's alerts and how each stood at its latest check.
  create     Add a rule that tells owners and admins when events or money look wrong.
  enable     Turn an alert back on.
  disable    Turn an alert off without deleting it.
  delete     Delete an alert.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash analytics alerts <command> --help' for more about a command.
